source_bands_basis: Broad manual brackets of the horizontal channel web faces in the inspected SNL Plate23 image; not metrology or acceptance tolerances.
findings: The source overlay retains the prior bearing-based local calibration. The fixed-frame hypothesis lowers both projected channels relative to the shaft by about55.8pixels; it worsens source agreement despite passing local mechanical fit.
Long MX5 bosses remain forward of the visible casting-wing silhouette. This already documented approximation is not resolved by rebuilding the webs.
The section at Y118 is chosen to expose the actual mount; the handbook cutting plane and out-of-plane details are uncertain.
Moving the frame with the shaft would restore its previous relative projection mathematically. That alternative still needs saved-geometry, hull/floor and attachment checks.
decision: Retain as a mechanically checked fixed-frame hypothesis; compare a frame-following-axis alternative before selecting the installation and rebuilding casings around it.
